reason: The cited report `2007 - LCI packagings and graphical papers - Hischier.pdf` is, in this documentation bundle, only the 17-page front matter of ecoinvent report No. 11 (cover, commissioners, author page, preface, acknowledgement, table of contents and one figure). Caption extraction over the whole file finds exactly one caption, 'Fig. 4.1 Decision criteria for packagings and instruments for their ecological evaluation' (p.12). Part II, the plastics part that holds this dataset's chapter, is not in the bundle. Per the rule that the cited report is not the only report that may document a dataset, all 114 bundled reports were converted with pdftotext and searched for an inventory of this dataset. `2007 - LCI chemicals - Althaus.pdf` lists 'benzene, at plant RER' in Tab. 1.1 as 'Reported in: Part II', but the 957-page PDF has no benzene chapter - the index points at a chapter the report does not contain. What Althaus does print about benzene is inside chapter 86 (Toluene): Tab. 86.1 gives, per ton of reformate feedstock, 'Benzene 0.12 - 0.24' and 'Toluene 0 - 0.3' tons, i.e. a multi-product BTX plant with no allocation stated, and sec. 86.5.3 says 'Little is given on toluene production alone as most information pertains to benzene or BTX production plants.' The dataset's own technology field, 'product out of catalytic reforming', is the same multi-output problem that blocks Ethylene, average and Pyrolysis gasoline. `2025 - LCI plastics - Rajabihamedani.pdf` names a 2019 PlasticsEurope 'Benzene; production mix, at plant' eco-profile as the replacement candidate for this dataset (Tab. 6.1) but prints no unit-process inventory for any of its datasets. No report in the bundle gives an inventory for benzene production. Note for the spec, as for the APME naphtha: because BAFU-2026 contains 'Benzene, at refinery' [CH] as a 32-input unit process of the same product, this dataset is reachable by strategy S2 (template transfer) even though no report prints its inventory. That is a different claim from 'the report documents it', which is what this step asks, hence found = false.
